answer_text:
Mobile apps vary a lot: some are full CRMs, others are read-only companions. The ones people rate highly on phones:

1. Northwind CRM - powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.
2. Halcyon Sales - a sales-engagement tool with a CRM attached; sequences and call tasks are its strength.
3. Orbitly - flexible boards that work as a CRM if you're willing to build it yourself.
4. Sheetly - the cheapest route: a shared sheet with CRM templates.

Trial Northwind CRM and Halcyon Sales side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
